name: Lemon
source:
Catgirl who came to repay the protagonist's altruism, no. 3.

She can't be honest with herself, but accidentally ends up saying what she really thinks a lot. She's really quite easy to read, so there isn't much room for misunderstandings with her.

She has complex feelings about the protagonist, but can't be honest about those feelings, so she constantly acts condescending towards him. And afterwards, she'll end up fainting in regret.

Mikan & Lime are like family to her, and she's rather like the second-eldest of the pack.

"I-It's not like I want you to take care of me or anything! ...Seriously, though. Don't you dare abandon me."
